title: Craftability Mod
description: Crafting recipes for uncraftable items and blocks
body:
Craftability is a Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that adds crafting recipes for vanilla items that normally cannot be crafted in survival.

This includes recipes for rare loot, utility items, and special blocks such as:

Enchanted Golden Apples
Bottles o’ Enchanting
Chainmail Armor
Saddles
Name Tags
Horse Armor
and other normally unobtainable or loot-only items.

The goal is to make survival worlds more self-sufficient by allowing players to obtain useful items through crafting instead of relying entirely on loot chests, villagers, or random drops.
